description: 00:00 - 01:15: Cement plug in c-annulus m 867 m) mixed and pumped 33 m3 of 1,95 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement with 12m3 of drill water. 1000 l/min/ 12 bar, after caught up w/ cement pressure went up to 52 bar. Stopped pumping, pressure went down to 31bar. Pulled w/ running tool out of EZSV, pressure dropped to 0 bar
